title: Conjugate symmetry of the probability inner product
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $Ω$, and let $f,g:Ω\to\mathbb C$. The complex conjugate of their probability-weighted inner product is the same inner product with $f$ and $g$ interchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $Ω$
